Hey Javed,

You are hired. Welcome to the team.

Before we go full speed I want to be straight with you about what this role actually requires — because I respect you enough to be honest from the start.

We are asking for **100 approved clips per month.** Not 100 submitted. Approved. I will be strict about the standard because the quality of every clip represents the brand. A clip that does not meet the standard gets sent back — it does not count until it is right.

That is the expectation and it will not change.

But here is my promise to you in return:

I will do everything on my end to make sure you have everything you need to hit that standard. I am recording new in depth videos specifically designed to show you exactly how to build a perfect clip — the pacing, the moment selection, the brand understanding, the editing style, everything. You will not be guessing. You will have full clarity on what we want and how to get there.

Because the goal is bigger than 100 clips. I am training you to become a **Lead Clipper** — someone who understands this brand deeply enough to approve other people's clips, lead a team, and earn up to $2,000 per month. That path starts now.

High standards on both sides. You deliver. I support. Together we build something real.

Contract is coming today or tomorrow. Stay ready.

Cleavon

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey team,

First, sorry for the delay lately. Upwork had us on hold and we couldn't move as fast as we wanted. That's sorted now, so we're back to full speed.

While we were on hold, I put together a new system to make your job easier and help you hit your 100 approved clips faster.

Here's what's new:

1\. Clip variations - you can now take the same body clip and change just the hook/opening to make a new version. You can reuse one clip up to 2-3 times this way. Less work, more clips.

2\. Shorter clip styles - these are quicker to make and easier to combine, so reaching 100 approved clips will be a lot smoother. Some of you could even push past 200 if you want.

3\. Hook training video - I'm making a video showing you how to find strong hooks. One long video can give you close to 50 clip ideas. This will make finding content faster and easier.

We see the work, loyalty, and commitment you've all put in, even with the delays on our end, and we appreciate it. This new system is to help you earn more without extra headaches.

Looking ahead, we want to build you up into Lead Clippers as we grow and bring more people onto the team. That starts with mastering this new approach.

More details and examples coming soon. Let's get back to it.

\- Cleavon
